name: memory
description: Personal persistent memory — auto-recalls relevant memories before each prompt and captures conversation summaries after each turn. Backed by Cloudflare Agent Memory (managed service with automatic extraction, classification, and hybrid search). Auth via Allen Labs SSO.

interface.longDescription: Automatically recalls relevant memories before each prompt and captures conversation summaries after each turn. Memories are stored in Cloudflare Agent Memory (managed service with automatic extraction, classification, and hybrid search). Authentication via Allen Labs SSO (JWT/JWKS).
